items.reason: Eligibility requires 'pediatric high-grade glioma (WHO Grade 3 or 4, including DMG/DIPG) or ATRT' and cites the WHO CNS5 classification; under CNS5, paediatric-type high-grade gliomas, DMG/DIPG and ATRT are not glioblastoma, so the D27C/R7 'grade 4 without IDH = historical GBM' logic does not apply. Glioblastoma is never named.

note: Outcome-neutral: Ages CHILD only (0-17), so the trial fails S4 (paediatric_only) before S5 and both coder values exclude it. XL to confirm that R7 (WHO grade 3-4 glioma = include) is not meant to cover a CNS5-cited paediatric-type HGG population; if R7 were applied literally the value would be mixed_glioma_gbm_named/historical, which conflicts with the CNS5 citation. Between the two exclusion values, high_grade_glioma_unspecified (coder A) is also defensible.
